t: This is the home of Elizabeth Finn Care, a British charity that helps people with the problems of old age, illness, social isolation and disability. It was founded in 1897 by Elizabeth Anne Finn as the Distressed Gentlefolk's Aid Association. She set it up with her daughter Constance. Finn was a writer, translator, artist and philanthropist, and the wife of James Finn, British Consul in Jerusalem. Since 2015 the charity has come under the Turn2us brand.
